commands.name: run
commands.note: `wf offload ask` runs one message on the rca service with the options of `opencode run` (opencode-run-options.json); the e2e parity tests hold the two to the same results

commands.name: [project]
commands.note: the TUI is interactive; a run is one request

commands.name: attach
commands.note: every run is attached to the rca service already

commands.name: serve
commands.note: the server is the service's opencode container, started by its compose project

commands.name: web
commands.note: the server is the service's opencode container

commands.name: acp
commands.note: no editor protocol: a run is one request

commands.name: agent
commands.note: agents are files of the project (.opencode/agents), sent with each run; `opencode agent list` lists them where opencode runs

commands.name: providers
commands.note: credentials are the service's, from its vault (`wf secret`); alias auth

commands.name: mcp
commands.note: MCP servers are config of the project, sent with each run; their credentials are the service's

commands.name: models
commands.note: the models a run may use are the ladder's (`wf offload ask --stats`) or pinned with -m

commands.name: session
commands.note: sessions live on the service for a day (`-s`, `-c` continue them); list and delete are not exposed

commands.name: stats
commands.note: `wf offload ask --stats` and `--savings` read the service's run log

commands.name: export
commands.note: sessions stay on the service

commands.name: import
commands.note: sessions stay on the service

commands.name: github
commands.note: GitHub automation runs in GitHub Actions with its own opencode

commands.name: pr
commands.note: checks out a pull request locally; the service has no checkout

commands.name: plugin
commands.note: plugins are files of the project or packages in its config, sent with each run

commands.name: db
commands.note: the database is the service's

commands.name: debug
commands.note: debugging tools of a local opencode

commands.name: completion
commands.note: shell completion of opencode itself

commands.name: upgrade
commands.note: the service's opencode version is its image's (backend/remote-chat-agent/opencode-server/Dockerfile)

commands.name: uninstall
commands.note: removes a local opencode
